name: Hydration
description: Measurement of epidermal water retention and cellular moisture levels.

interpretation.low: Severe transepidermal water loss. Skin barrier requires humectant infusion.
interpretation.medium: Moderate hydration. Minor dryness in seasonal transitions.
interpretation.high: Optimal barrier hydration with supple cellular volume.

name: Oil Balance
description: Sebum production equilibrium across the T-zone and U-zone facial quadrants.

interpretation.low: Alipic skin lacking essential lipid barrier oils.
interpretation.medium: Balanced lipidic secretion with minimal sheen.
interpretation.high: Hyperactive sebaceous activity leading to congestion.

name: Texture
description: Micro-relief smoothness, cellular turnover rate, and dermal topography regularity.

interpretation.low: Keratinized rough patches and sluggish desquamation.
interpretation.medium: Standard dermal texture with localized minor roughness.
interpretation.high: Silky, ultra-refined micro-topography with luminous light reflection.

name: Pigmentation
description: Melanin distribution uniformity, UV sun spots, and post-inflammatory marks.

interpretation.low: Visible dyschromia, solar lentigines, or melasma patches.
interpretation.medium: Subtle localized hyperpigmentation near orbital & malar zones.
interpretation.high: Flawless, crystal-clear tone uniformity with zero visible discoloration.

name: Acne and Blemishes
description: Follicular congestion, comedones, and active inflammatory papules detection.

interpretation.low: Frequent breakouts, micro-cysts, and active follicular inflammation.
interpretation.high: Completely clarified, calm complexion free of inflammatory lesions.

name: Fine Lines
description: Collagen elasticity index, dynamic expression lines, and dermal matrix firmness.

interpretation.low: Pronounced periorbital crow's feet and nascent nasolabial folds.
interpretation.medium: Early dehydration fine lines visible under harsh lighting.
interpretation.high: Plump, youthful elastin tension with resilient rebound.

name: Redness and Sensitivity
description: Microvascular reactivity, capillary flush, erythema, and barrier fragility.

interpretation.low: Hypersensitive barrier with persistent flushing or telangiectasia.
interpretation.medium: Mild transient redness triggered by thermal shifts or spicy foods.
interpretation.high: Resilient neurosensory threshold with calm, unperturbed tone.

name: Pore Visibility
description: Pilosebaceous ostia diameter and follicular elasticity around central facial zones.

interpretation.low: Dilated, congested follicular pores with visible architectural stretching.
interpretation.medium: Standard visible pores concentrated primarily on nasal wings.
interpretation.high: Porcelain-smooth, tightened pore architecture invisible to the naked eye.
